description: Source code implementing Wi-Fi support functions for Texas Instruments SimpleLink hardware, including event handlers, configuration, and network management.

methods.name: configure_simplelink
methods.description: Configures the SimpleLink Wi-Fi device to default state, including role, IP, and scan settings.

methods.name: SimpleLinkWlanEventHandler
methods.description: Handles WLAN events such as connect, disconnect, and station added/removed.

methods.name: SimpleLinkNetAppEventHandler
methods.description: Handles network application events like IP address acquisition and lease.

methods.name: SimpleLinkGeneralEventHandler
methods.description: Handles general device events and errors.

methods.name: SimpleLinkFatalErrorEventHandler
methods.description: Handles fatal errors requiring device restart.

methods.name: z_simplelink_get_scan_result
methods.description: Retrieves scan result details for a specific network index.

methods.name: z_simplelink_start_scan
methods.description: Initiates Wi-Fi network scan and populates network list.

methods.name: z_simplelink_get_mac
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address of the device.

methods.name: z_simplelink_connect
methods.description: Connects to a Wi-Fi network with specified parameters.

methods.name: z_simplelink_disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: z_simplelink_init
methods.description: Initializes the SimpleLink Wi-Fi interface with a callback.
